description: Test suite for a Flask application, testing dog retrieval API endpoints with mock database queries.

classes.name: TestApp
classes.description: Unit test case class for testing Flask app endpoints related to dog data.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test client and configures app for testing.

methods.name: _create_mock_dog
methods.description: Creates a mock dog object with specified id, name, and breed.

methods.name: _setup_query_mock
methods.description: Configures mock query to return specified list of dog objects.

methods.name: test_get_dogs_success
methods.description: Tests successful retrieval of multiple dog records.

methods.name: test_get_dogs_empty
methods.description: Tests API response when no dog records are available.

methods.name: test_get_dogs_structure
methods.description: Verifies the structure of the response data for a single dog.
